say:1:1430124101:1.text: Thanks, but what I need are some experienced Dwarven miners.
say:1:1430124101:1.source_cn: 帮忙？哦，谢谢你的热心，不过我更需要一些有经验的矮人矿工。
say:1:1430124101:1.male: Thanks, but what I need are some experienced Dwarven miners.
say:1:1430124101:1.female: Thanks, but what I need are some experienced Dwarven miners.

say:2:1430124102:1.text: Because the echorite mine is extremely dangerous! Like deathly dangerous!
say:2:1430124102:1.source_cn: 因为生产深岩晶的矿区……非常危险，没错，十分的危险！

say:3:1430124103:1.text: Even experienced miners have to be careful.
say:3:1430124103:1.source_cn: 就算是经验丰富的矿工到那里也需要十分谨慎。
